selection_reason: On validation, 960 and 1280 both detect 8/8 with one FP after deduplication. At padding 0.08, 960 covers >=95% of all 8 GT boxes, versus 6/8 at 1280, and is faster. 640 needs confidence 0.02 and produces 3 FP. Thresholds selected by validation F2. ONNX real-image parity passed and measured CPU latency is lower.
scope: Pilot model: 34 real 4000x3000 images; session independence and real 48MP accuracy unverified. No camera, Stage 2 or OCR.
